clock_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the clock line of the light, for two-wire lights.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

data_pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the data line of the light, for two-wire lights.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

invert.docs:
**boolean**: Invert data output, for use with n-type transistors. Defaults to `no`.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

method.docs:
**string**: The method used to transmit the data. By default, ESPHome will try to use the best method available for this chipset, ESP platform, and the given pin. See [methods](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#methods) for more information.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

num_leds.docs:
**int**: The number of LEDs attached.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

pin.docs:
**[Pin](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin)**: The pin for the data line of the light.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

type.docs:
**string**: The type of light. This is used to specify if it is an RGBW or RGB light and in which order the colors are. Defaults to `GRB`. Change this if you have lights with white channel and/or the colors are in the wrong order.

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*

variant.docs:
**string**: The chipset of the light. The following options are supported:

*See also: [NeoPixelBus Light](https://esphome.io/components/light/neopixelbus#configuration-variables)*
